title: Axe chopping wood
author: xkeril
sourceFormat: Public HQ MP3 preview, decoded as 48000 Hz mono, 12.923 seconds. This is not the original 24-bit WAV described on the author page.
authorDescription: Small axe striking a large dry wooden branch; outdoor mono recording, cleaned and equalized by the original author.
usage: Adapted recording used by combat.impact.tree for tree damage and chopping, not merely a style reference.

processing.modifications: Three individual recorded strikes trimmed from the public HQ preview; remove DC, apply one common gain preserving differences, short edge fades, and export 48 kHz mono PCM16 WAV. No synthesized layers, time stretching, pitch alteration, or LMMS rendering.
